mutation_payload: u8 operation tag snapshot=0 insert=1 update=2 delete=3

hashing.field_framing: u64-be byte length followed by bytes

identity_encodings.canonical_key: u32-be component count; each component is one-byte representation tag (bool=1,int64=2,uint64=3,bytes=4,text=5), u32-be PostgreSQL type OID (bool 16; int64 21/23/20; uint64 OID 26; bytes 17/2950; text 25/1043/1042/19), i32-be typmod, then bool as one byte, integers as eight-byte big-endian, or bytes/text as u64-be byte length plus raw unpadded-base64url-decoded/UTF-8 bytes
identity_encodings.logical_table_id: u64-be system_identifier, UTF-8 database_identity, UTF-8 schema name, UTF-8 table name; each field receives outer u64 length framing
identity_encodings.relation_component_hash: SHA-256 over outer-length-framed domain boring-cdc/relation-component/v1, UTF-8 component kind, and canonical UTF-8 definition. Definitions are PostgreSQL catalog-deparsed expressions/index/partition/publication forms with identifiers UTF-8, keywords lower-case, one ASCII space between tokens, no comments, no trailing semicolon, and numeric literals in minimal decimal form.
identity_encodings.source_slot_identity: u64-be system_identifier, u32-be timeline, UTF-8 database_identity, UTF-8 slot name, UTF-8 plugin; each field receives outer u64 length framing

limits.units: bytes (octets); limits are inclusive over canonical decoded bytes

relation_contract_encoding: u64-length-framed logical_table_id; u32-be relation_id; u32-be physical-column count; each physical attnum ascending: i16-be attnum, u32-be logical ordinal (ffffffff if dropped), framed UTF-8 name (empty only if dropped), one-byte dropped, u32-be type OID, i32-be typmod, u32-be collation OID, one-byte nullable, framed SHA-256 default-expression hash or empty, framed SHA-256 generated-expression hash or empty, framed SHA-256 identity-expression hash or empty; one-byte replica mode d=0 n=1 f=2 i=3; framed replica-index definition hash or empty; framed primary/unique effective-key definition hash; framed partition-root logical_table_id or empty; framed partition-routing definition hash or empty; framed partition-key hash or empty; framed partition-bounds hash or empty; one-byte publication action bits INSERT=1 UPDATE=2 DELETE=4 TRUNCATE=8; one-byte publication membership; framed publication row-filter hash or empty; framed publication column-projection hash or empty

value_types.canonical: IEEE-754 binary32 big-endian; preserve signed zero; all NaNs become 7fc00000
IEEE-754 binary64 big-endian; preserve signed zero; all NaNs become 7ff8000000000000
UTF-8 minimal decimal: no plus, exponent, leading/trailing zero, or negative zero; NaN and infinity unsupported
signed int32 big-endian days since 2000-01-01; infinities int32 min/max
signed int64 big-endian microseconds since 2000-01-01; infinities int64 min/max; no timezone conversion
signed int64 big-endian UTC microseconds since 2000-01-01; infinities int64 min/max
exact UTF-8 bytes after PostgreSQL type semantics; no connector Unicode normalization
u32-be count, then each element as state tag plus u32-be OID, i32-be typmod, u64-be length and canonical bytes; lower bound must be 1
value_types.pg: one-dimensional arrays of admitted non-array scalars
